request: 插件功能需要增加升级按钮，点击升级在线替换
acceptance: Each plugin has an Upgrade button; configured sources upgrade directly without upload. Unknown sources can be entered once; official plugin IDs default to the official immutable GitHub snapshot.

Bounded authenticated download, safe ZIP and ID validation, optional checksum, retained settings/enablement/data/dependencies and old files/registry rollback set. Failed validation/start/persistence restores the prior plugin; interrupted swaps recover at startup.

Upgrade waits for active tool calls, serializes lifecycle mutations, prevents duplicate upgrades and invalidates queued calls on replaced code. Actual API, real Safari UI and full main regression required.

requirements.summary: User requests an upgrade button for online replacement. Optional source clarification pending; default official IDs use AIDE GitHub, custom plugins use manifest/user HTTPS ZIP URL.

design.summary: Reuse ZIP validation; download before exclusive plugin resource admission. Copy bounded local state, probe staged candidate/dependencies, journal rename swap, preserve enablement/settings and rollback set. Recover interrupted swaps on startup. UI busy state and source dialog.
